name: snap-to-grid
description: A horseshoe magnet with solid pole tips beside three grid points.
useCase: Snap moved objects to points on the canvas grid.
misuse: Use a label to distinguish grid snapping from guide snapping.

16.reason: Solid pole caps keep the smaller magnet readable beside separated grid points.

24.reason: A wider curved band and larger grid points preserve the magnet and grid relationship.
